says: Two pointers to where edge-comment's laws live are wrong after 0591 slice A: edge-config.test.ts's header says the planted half is edge-comment.integration.test.ts, which no longer exists (it is oxlint-plugins/edge-comment.test.ts), and oxlint-plugins/README.md:383 says edge-comment.test.ts checks that the .agents/ mirror block equals next/**'s, which now names oxlint-plugins/edge-comment.test.ts, a file that holds no such law (the mirror law is in next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/edge-config.test.ts).
proof: next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/edge-config.test.ts:3-4 reads 'The planted half, which spawns oxlint in a temp folder, is edge-comment.integration.test.ts.' while git ls-tree 3f7dd39 has no next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/edge-comment.integration.test.ts; oxlint-plugins/README.md:383 reads '`edge-comment.test.ts` checks the two blocks are equal' while oxlint-plugins/edge-comment.test.ts holds only the four planted-comment laws and the 'pinned: the .agents/ override repeats the next/** rule block exactly (0033)' law is in next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/edge-config.test.ts.
cost: A reader or agent looking for the .agents/ mirror law or the planted edge-comment laws follows a pointer to the wrong file or to a missing file.
